name: Zsolt Varjú
summary: Software developer and platform operator, deliberately broader than full stack. I build web applications end to end, design the ETL pipelines that feed them, and run the production infrastructure they depend on. On a project for the European Space Agency I own and run a platform that delivers quality reports and data unavailability reports from Earth observation satellites, aggregating validated data from ESA, legacy and third-party missions, from choosing the approach to keeping it running in production. AI-assisted development is a core working method, not a novelty. Heading towards system architecture.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Own and run, end to end, a platform that delivers quality reports and data unavailability reports from Earth observation satellites on a project for the European Space Agency, aggregating validated data from ESA, legacy and third-party missions: from the user interface down to the servers it runs on.
Choose the approach, technologies and architecture for new work, present the solution, build it, test it on UAT, deploy it to production, then monitor, fix, patch and back it up.
React frontend and Node.js backend over a search stack built on Apache Solr, with RabbitMQ for messaging, Neo4j for relationships and Tika for document extraction, all containerised.

Design and operate multi-mission ingestion pipelines and scripts in Python: scheduled transfers, search schema design, and table extraction from PDFs and spreadsheets with rejection audits returned to the data owners.

Run Ubuntu servers on Azure: nginx routing and TLS, access control, containerised services, CI/CD, updates and patches, backups, monitoring, and regular vulnerability remediation under formal change control.

Led a phased frontend quality programme: vendor bundle cut by roughly three quarters, JavaScript payload down a third, CSS down more than half, every outstanding lint error cleared, unnecessary React re-renders reduced by 80%.
Work directly with mission teams and IT: requirements, brainstorming and solution proposals, formal bug reports, escalations, change records and effort estimates.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Tester
bullets: Manual functional testing of web pages across browsers and devices, identifying and reporting defects.
Verified pages against graphic design specifications and fed detailed corrections back to designers and developers.
Maintained quality standards across a large portfolio of Slovak municipal and commercial websites.
Documented test results and corrective actions, working independently to fixed deadlines.
